title: Desire To Transform
paragraphs: “Listen, I’ve told you many times—resolving everything with violence isn’t the best approach.”
Right now, I’m being lectured by Father.
Oh? Looks like Ren and Itsuki have arrived. As expected, they look completely exhausted today as well.
“Naofumi-san… you tricked me…”
Itsuki, sliding off Sakura-chan’s back, reached toward Father with a bitter expression.
What’s this? Speaking ill of Father? How dare he?
“Huh!? Why am I the one getting blamed here?”
“Because… you tricked me into thinking that riding Sakura-san would prevent motion sickness.”
Kweh! Sakura-chan let out a proud cry. Looks like Itsuki has been leveling up steadily as well.
“Wait, wait! I never said that!”
“You gave me false hope, and that’s the problem.”
That said, he does seem a bit better than yesterday.
Maybe he’s gradually getting used to it?
“At first, the medicine was helping, but as time went on, it got worse.”
Ren also looks completely drained. Yuki-chan gracefully lifted him up, helping him stand. I can almost see flowers blooming in the background.
“So, what about lunch?”
“No problem there. We fought monsters on foot until we thought we might be late, but then this one here forced us onto her back and took off at full speed.”
“I really thought riding Sakura-san would keep me from getting sick…”
So, it turned into an impromptu road trip? Itsuki is a fool.
“Sigh… If only there were a useful skill like Motion Sickness Resistance.”
“Since you don’t even have Language Comprehension, you really think something that convenient would exist?”
“It does exist.”

Motion Sickness Resistance does exist. Some monsters have attacks that disrupt the inner ear, similar to paralysis effects. That skill was developed as a countermeasure, but it also works against alcohol-induced dizziness and motion sickness.
Oh? Ren and Itsuki just slowly lifted their heads and glared at me.
What? I simply stated a fact.
“Say that earlier!”
“This is just like this morning… I guess that means there might be a Motion Sickness Immunity skill too?”
“Unfortunately, I haven’t seen one.”
“So that one doesn’t exist.”
“I actually asked Father about it in our previous world, but he said he’d never seen it before.”
“If someone never gets motion sick to begin with, they wouldn’t need resistance in the first place.”
“Having the same skill multiple times strengthens it. I bet Father’s weapons have already adapted to include that ability.”
No matter how much we learn, there are always new discoveries to be made with the Hero’s weapons.
“Ugh… I’m jealous that the Heroes get abilities like that… gah!”
Oh? Éclair seems completely out of it.
Should I use a spell to alleviate status ailments?
“Oh, right! Ren, Itsuki! Motoyasu messed up again!”
“Naofumi, you need to keep Motoyasu in check!”
“Exactly!”
“You both know that’s impossible for me alone!”
What are they arguing about now? Father began explaining my great achievement from today to Ren and Itsuki.
“Damn… I guess we can’t stay in this country any longer.”
“Someone needs to keep an eye on him and stop him from running wild.”
“If we don’t watch him, he’ll misinterpret things and go berserk again…”
Father and the others are discussing something.
“For now, shouldn’t we start moving?”
“Yeah. We never know when we’ll be declared wanted criminals.”
“A bunch of thugs might even storm the inn.”
They seem a bit anxious. But such trivial matters are nothing before my strength. If they come, I’ll simply slaughter them all.
“There’s no problem. As long as you properly apply the strengthening methods I taught you, even at a low level, handling regular adventurers is trivial.”

Still, leaving before the Filolials’ outfits are complete would be troublesome. I refuse to move until Father and the others can witness everyone’s grand appearance. After all, my goal is to make Ren and Itsuki truly appreciate the magnificence of the Filolials. Tonight will be a spectacle.
“This guy completely disregards the fact that people might come at him out of sheer pride!”
“Well, those who got attacked by Motoyasu will probably try to stop him with their lives on the line.”
Father and the others start looking around. I’ll take a look as well.
Oh? There are people observing us from the shadows of a building. Some are even watching from high in the sky.
Shall I issue a warning?
“Air St—”
“Oh crap! Naofumi! Stop Motoyasu!”
“U-Uh, yeah! Motoyasu-kun, calm down!”
“Javelin! This is just a warning shot. I’ll do my best to follow Father’s orders, of course.”

I released my skill just enough to graze the cheek of the beastman bat observing us from above. A subtle way of letting them know—if they interfere unnecessarily, they will be eliminated. I can’t quite tell if they’re pale with fear due to the backlight, but this should be enough to deter them from making any rash moves.
“He’s not stopping at all!”
“I am following orders.”
“You call this holding back…? Well, at least we won’t be relaxing any time soon.”
“Are we just going to keep making more and more enemies like this…?”
“Let’s just hope things go the way Motoyasu expects. Either way, we should strengthen ourselves as much as possible. Even the armor Motoyasu gave us is starting to feel lighter.”
Father and the others nod in agreement. It seems we are of one mind.
“For now, since Motoyasu tends to go on a rampage when left alone, we should always have at least one person stay behind to keep an eye on him.”
Ren suggests this, and Itsuki nods repeatedly.

“That’s a great idea. That way, I can rest without getting motion sick. We’ve already gained plenty of levels today, and I don’t think rushing things like Naofumi-san does is always the best approach.”
Even Ren, after suggesting it himself, mutters that it’s actually a great idea.

“I see… Well, our levels have gone up a bit, and as long as we have the materials, we should be able to strengthen our equipment. So we can manage both. In the end, even if we make a big move, we’ll still be in this country for a few more days, huh?”
Father summed it up, and both Ren and Itsuki seemed to agree.
But why am I the one being monitored?
“So? What’s for dinner tonight? Are we eating Naofumi’s cooking?”
“I made dinner last night and lunch today. Since we’re stronger now, why don’t we eat out for a change?”
“Agreed. That said, given the discrimination in this country, our dining options are mostly limited to food stalls. Though, I suppose a tavern might work too.”
“Wait, aren’t these Filolials supposed to transform tonight? If we have them pretend to be demi-humans and act like we’re their companions, we should be able to eat at a proper restaurant.”
“That makes sense!”
“We could make cat ears or dog ears ourselves and pretend to be demi-humans…”

When Father suggested that, Ren and Itsuki gave him a look that screamed, What is he even talking about? Is there a problem? I, for one, would be happy to wear them. Ideally, I’d like a crest feather like Filo-tan’s.
“Come on, guys. A guy wearing cat ears would be a bit much, don’t you think?”
“Eh? But…”

Father glanced over at the demi-humans walking by. There it was—a seriously buff, muscular cat-eared demi-human. As Father stared, the guy flexed his pecs in response. I will not allow this. I stepped in front of him to block his view.
“I mean… I guess it’s not impossible, but you’d still get caught because you wouldn’t be able to mimic all the subtle movements.”
“I see… The other option, though I’d rather not, would be getting bitten by a vampire?”
I’ve seen this in movies before. The whole get bitten by a vampire and turn into one trope. No idea if that’s how vampires work in this world, though.
“Rejected.”
“I have zero interest in that.”
“Werewolf, then?”
“Stop it with the monster transformation ideas, Naofumi.”
“Do you really want to turn into a beastman that badly?”
Oh? Does Father secretly have a desire to transform?
“I mean, you got all excited like a kid when you saw panda and elephant beastmen.”
“T-That’s not it! I was just excited because it was a different world, that’s all!”
“Anyway, let’s not focus on ways to stop being human.”
“We don’t even know if it’s possible, and I wouldn’t want to test it.”
“Apparently, there is a kind of magic that lets you transform into an animal.”
Father and the others gave me a look of exasperation.
“And what exactly would be the point of us transforming?”
“I’m not entirely sure. I just remember that magic shop owner who taught Father magic once held a lecture on it.”

Technically, it was a review lesson Father gave us about a lecture he attended at the magic shop earlier that day. I vaguely recall hearing that the first time you transform, you don’t get to choose what you turn into. We never tested it out, though. Didn’t see a need for it.
“Wait… what were we talking about again? Feels like we got sidetracked by Motoyasu’s nonsense.”
“We wanted to eat out, but we can’t easily get into a good restaurant.”
“Ah, right. So we were going to wait until Sakura-chan and the others transformed.”
“Yeah. I’m a little hungry, but I can hold out.”
“Honestly, I’d be fine with just eating Naofumi’s cooking at this point. I’m starving, like the Filolials.”
“That would completely defeat the purpose.”
“But we don’t know when they’re going to transform.”
“Hopefully soon…”
Right then, Sakura-chan responded to Father’s request and attempted to transform. She spread her feathers wide…
“Kweh.”
…But nothing happened.
“You got our hopes up for nothing.”
“She just needs a little more time. Almost there.”

Originally, the transformation was supposed to happen tomorrow night. I only sped up their growth a little, so it’s just happening a day earlier than planned. That said, the Filolials are still making their usual growth sounds.
